evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/k/p constructs reviewed rs/k/o (Skybox) from getClass().getResourceAsStream("skybox.txt") and passes the same literal "skybox.txt" to its constructor.

Its private (int,int,int)->int helper subtracts client base X/Y divided by 8, selects the requested plane from the instance-template chunk array, range-checks both coordinates, returns -1 out of bounds and otherwise returns the selected chunk value.

RuneLite SkyboxPlugin preserves the same distinctive skybox.txt construction and mapChunk algorithm. Together with the adjacent exact-v308 Skybox parser lineage, this recovers the upstream class noun rather than guessing from package adjacency.

Exact v308 GPU initialization constructs rs/k/p into Client.b, and both reviewed client render paths invoke rs/k/p.a() only when the GPU renderer is active; the hook checks skybox/runtime state and reads the local-player coordinate state.

proposals.note: Source-provenance semantic recovery. SpawnPK's rs/k/p is a pruned/adapted RuneLite-derived wrapper rather than a byte-identical copy, but the paired skybox.txt constructor and chunk-mapping fingerprint are sufficiently specific to recover the upstream SkyboxPlugin class noun. This supersedes R91's earlier conservative decision to leave rs/k/p unnamed.
